criteria.text: Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 9.5 is stated as $44,062,500 but 15% of the $235,000,000 Purchase Price is $35,250,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.

Identifies the threatened $1,200,000 claim by Saltash Software Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Explains how 'material adverse effect' could be read narrowly or broadly and what each reading means for the Buyer's walk-away right.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (15% x $235,000,000 = $35,250,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $44,062,500.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
